_comment: Scene 9 = DROID-BlockStackKitchen (ported from PolaRiS owhan/PolaRiS-Hub `block_stack_kitchen`). Task: 'Place and stack the blocks on top of the green tray' -- pick up both cubes, place them in the green tray, and stack the green cube on the wooden cube. Objects are PolaRiS's scanned USDZ meshes (custom/block_stack_kitchen/) spawned via kind:'usd_rigid'. The green tray is the fixed TARGET (kinematic, stable) at a lightly-randomized pose; the two ~6cm cubes are the pick+stack objects (randomized off the tray, see eval/scene_specs.py::SCENES[9]). PolaRiS per-object scales are kept (USDZ meshes in arbitrary units). All meshes are XY-centered, base at local z=0, so pos.z = table-top rest height (~0.045-0.05). Base scene9_0.usd = empty table+dome+robot. NOTE: first-cut layout for our smaller workspace (x~[0.30,0.60], y~[-0.12,0.24]); verify cube graspability + tray reach in a smoke render and nudge poses if needed. Distractors (tomato, corn) are a curated subset of PolaRiS's kitchen clutter (full library in custom/block_stack_kitchen/).
